name: How long does a kitchen addition project typically take?
description: Kitchen addition timelines vary from 8 weeks to over 6 months, depending on size, complexity, and permitting. Communication is key to managing expectations.

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen addition project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen addition varies significantly based on its size, complexity, and local permitting processes. A smaller bump-out might take 8-12 weeks, while a full new room addition could extend to 4-6 months or more from design to completion. Factors like material availability, weather, and the speed of inspections can also impact the schedule. Hometelligent Inc. focuses on clear communication throughout the project, providing regular updates on progress and any potential adjustments to the timeline, ensuring you're informed every step of the way.
